title: RevClamp TalentPulse - Unified 5-in-1 B2B ATS Job & Hiring Signal Feed
description: Resolve and normalize active B2B job postings, compensation bands, workplace classification (REMOTE / HYBRID / ONSITE), and technology stack hiring signals across Greenhouse, Workday CXS, Ashby, Lever, and SmartRecruiters. Leave defaults intact and click Start to run an instant verification query for Linear.

query.title: Company Slug, Career URL, or Brand Name
query.description: Company slug (e.g. 'linear', 'stripe', 'nvidia', 'zoox', 'BoschGroup') or direct ATS career board URL (Greenhouse, Workday myworkdayjobs.com, Ashby, Lever, or SmartRecruiters).

provider.title: ATS Provider Override (Optional)
provider.description: Explicit ATS provider override. Leave as AUTO to automatically detect from URL, curated directory, or live ATS board resolution.

searchKeyword.title: Role / Keyword Filter (Optional)
searchKeyword.description: Case-insensitive filter applied across job title, department, location, and tech stack keywords (e.g. 'Engineer', 'Security', 'Python').

workplaceType.title: Workplace Type Filter
workplaceType.description: Filter normalized job postings by workplace classification.

departmentKeyword.title: Department Filter (Optional)
departmentKeyword.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on normalized department name (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Sales', 'Product').

maxResults.title: Max Job Postings to Return
maxResults.description: Maximum number of normalized job postings to return in a single call (bounded to 1..50).

cursor.title: Pagination Cursor (Optional)
cursor.description: Opaque deterministic pagination cursor (rtp1_...) returned by a previous call to resume fetching the next slice.

company.title: Company Name or Slug (Alias)
company.description: Optional alias for query (company name or slug, e.g. 'stripe', 'linear').

domain.title: Company Domain (Alias)
domain.description: Optional alias for query (company domain, e.g. 'stripe.com', 'linear.app').

url.title: Career Board URL (Alias)
url.description: Optional alias for query / careerUrl (direct career board URL).

countryCode.title: Country Filter (ISO-2)
countryCode.description: Optional 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code filter (e.g. 'US', 'DE', 'GB', or 'ALL').

country.title: Country Filter (Alias)
country.description: Optional alias for countryCode (2-letter ISO country code, e.g. 'US', 'DE', 'GB').

region.title: Region / Country Filter (Alias)
region.description: Optional alias for countryCode (2-letter ISO country code, e.g. 'US', 'DE', 'GB').
